text:
Hi Sam,
You're absolutely right, that's a really interesting point. Honestly, I don't think we can be so sure that's a typewriter. Sometimes the font just looks very monospace, and it may have been chosen to avoid the problem of identifying who leaked the documents. I don't think they wanted to give too much of a hint. Also, a lot of the documents are scanned, and in those cases, they're using a different font altogether. But yeah, I completely agree, I think they're trying to be as obscure as possible. We'll be using some of those documents in the upcoming show, and I'm really looking forward to the premiere.
Cheers,
Katherine
prediction: We believe that this entire text is human-written.
headline: Human Written
